preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(char, str) and len(char) == 1 for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of single-character strings.

postconditions.expression: all(char in s for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be present in the input string.
Each character in the output must appear more than once in the input string.
The output must contain unique characters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(char) == s.index(char, s.index(char) + 1) for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: The order of characters in the output must be the order of their first repetition in the input string.
